name: web_egg
question: Does a spider egg (WebbEgg1) web a mech that moves next to it, or one placed next to it? (Recordings: mechs that moved next to an egg were webbed.)
mission: any mission without an environment, player turn 1-3, not the last turn
observe: After SCENARIO: mech 1 at (3,4), placed next to the egg, webbed (unit.web / grappled)?
After the move: mech 0 at (2,3), next to the egg, webbed?
After End Turn: webs are released first; the egg hatches a Spiderling at (3,3) only when its queued hatch fires.
